chapter_title_en: The Pact of Ten Thousand Swords
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0280 – The Pact of Ten Thousand Swords: Ji Ning's Bold Alliance
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning strikes a desperate deal. He offers the demons of the Immortal Estate their freedom in exchange for protecting his tribe for a thousand years. A new army marches on Ten Thousand Swords City.
og_title: Desolate Era – Ji Ning Blackmails… I Mean, Negotiates With a Demon Army
og_description: Ji Ning and 30,000 demon soldiers swear a Heavenly Oath. The Shaoyan Clan is about to find Ten Thousand Swords City is no easy target.
twitter_title: The demon army marches to Ten Thousand Swords City!
twitter_description: Ji Ning makes an impossible deal: freedom for the demons of the Immortal Estate in exchange for a thousand years of protection for his tribe.

lore_anchors.definition: A magically binding vow sworn under the gaze of the Heavenly Dao. Breaking it invites certain doom during one's next tribulation, making it the ultimate contract for Xian cultivators.
A key that allows passage in and out of a sealed pocket dimension, such as the Immortal Wu Jiang estate. Ji Ning uses it as his primary bargaining chip.
A portable formation set named after the legendary sage Fuxi, used by Ji Ning to seal space around himself during the negotiation.
The Grand Xia city that serves as the ancestral home of the Ji Clan.
Magical armor inscribed with runes that allows multiple wearers to link their power, drastically amplifying their combat effectiveness as a unit.
A powerful cultivator who failed the Celestial Tribulation and survived as a 'scattered immortal,' bound to physical form and suffering periodic, increasingly powerful tribulations.
A transcendent being who has successfully passed the Celestial Tribulation, gaining immortality and immense power. They are the cornerstones of the most powerful clans.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Ji Ning just keep the Immortal Estate Key and use the estate himself?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The estate is a stationary pocket dimension; it cannot be moved. Ji Ning already has a far superior, portable training ground (the aquatic palace of Daoist Threelives). The Key’s best use is as a bargaining chip to secure a mobile army.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the demons so willing to accept a thousand-year contract?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They have been trapped in a small, barren world for generations. A thousand years of guarding a city in the vast Grand Xia is a short-term price to pay for permanent, unrestricted freedom in a boundless universe. The deal is a lottery win for them.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Can a Heavenly Oath be broken?
cultural_notes_faq.a: For anyone who cultivates the Dao (Zifu and above), breaking a Heavenly Oath is effectively suicide. The backlash during their next tribulation is amplified to the point of near-certain death. For powerhouses like Loose Immortals, this is absolute.
